Exercise 5 — Paraphrasing Sentences  
Rewrite each sentence using advanced academic vocabulary:  
1. Many students go abroad because universities there provide better 
education.  
2. Living in another country helps people understand different cultures.  
3. Some students feel lonely and stressed when they study far from 
home.  
4. Studying abroad can be very expensive.  
5. Language problems can hinder students' academic success.  
 
Essay Topic  
Many students choose to study abroad nowadays.  
Do the advantages of studying abroad outweigh the disadvantages?
